name: Thor Fernholm
heroHeadline: Engineering reliable AI agents, from research to production.
heroSubtitle: I'm an AI & ML engineer with a foundation in full-stack software development — from open-source RAG pipelines to tool-calling architectures for AI agents. I care most about the fundamental engineering challenges of making agents and ML reliable and useful.
aboutText: I'm an AI & ML engineer with a foundation in full-stack software development, currently finishing an M.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering with a specialisation in AI and Machine Learning at Linköping University. My master's thesis, built with Modular Finance, is a programmatic tool-calling framework for a commercial AI agent — benchmarked against traditional in-context tool-calling and evaluated through custom pipelines and user testing. The summer before, I engineered an open-source retrieval-augmented generation pipeline for financial data as a reusable Go library, released as ragnar. Before moving into AI, I spent several years as a full-stack developer at Opter, modernising a transport management system used by logistics dispatchers across the Nordics in C# .NET, MAUI, and SQL, and interned as a data engineer at Ericsson. I'm especially excited about closing the gap between AI research and systems that actually hold up in production.
